referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for an office building with offices only (no kitchen, restaurant or car park). The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 2621 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 4000 m3/h, total weight of the components: 2590 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 1.5 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: f3ab93e7-d2eb-3827-acdb-a8d6cde65e9e
